module: "Freeform Delivery Debug" imgui debug window of the freeform delivery mode. When enabled (setEnableDebugWindow(true)), it collects the current delivery's state every frame and displays sections: delivery state, setup state, couplings, vehicles, goals, target areas, routes, parking spots and vehicle sleep. Useful to a modder for debugging a delivery.json file.
notes: The window is controlled only by enableDebugWindow (setEnableDebugWindow / getEnableDebugWindow). toggleDebugWindow only modifies debugWindowOpen, a variable that is never read: calling it (as gameplay_freeformDelivery_freeformDelivery.load does) therefore opens nothing.
When debug is disabled, the collected data is cleared. Without a loaded delivery, the window displays "No delivery loaded".
Collection and drawing happen in onPreRender, not in onUpdate.

setEnableDebugWindow.desc: Enables or disables the display of the debug window. Disabling clears the collected data.

getEnableDebugWindow.desc: Tells whether the debug window is enabled.

toggleDebugWindow.desc: Inverts debugWindowOpen and logs the new state; no visible effect (see notes).

onPreRender.desc: Hook called before rendering each frame: if the window is enabled, updates the debug data from gameplay_freeformDelivery_freeformDelivery then draws the window.
